title: Ivo and the Contact
author: Jude Almeida
blurb: Beatrix Halloran, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
